releaseNotes:
• Supabase Cloud Multi-Device Sync: Unified Postgres user_profiles & user_sync_state with Row-Level Security across Android APK & Web (https://pulseforge.feenixs.com).
• Sign In with Google (OAuth) + Email/Password: Shared Supabase Auth on both Web and Android (pulseforge://auth/callback).
• Mandatory Auth Gate & Unified Version Control: Always opens on Sign In / Sign Up with v1.9.0 (Build 22) synced between APK and Web.
